We’ll need to confirm whether a restock order will be placed before we can give you a firm update.

Best,
Campus Customs

We have 8 medium navy hoodies available now. A bulk price of $52.20 each (10% off the $58 list price) has been approved for those 8 units only. We are short 12 units for your requested quantity of 20, and no restock has been ordered, so we cannot currently confirm the remaining 12. Please let us know whether you would like to proceed with the 8 available hoodies or prefer another option.

This is a draft for staff review and has not been sent.
